headline: Ravens are much different with and without Lamar Jackson
summary: As expected, given that he's week-to-week with an ankle injury, Ravens quarterback Lamar Jackson will miss Sunday night's game against the Falcons.

headline: Giants expect Nabers, Thomas, Skattebo and Likely to play Sunday
summary: New York Giants wide receiver Malik Nabers is expected to play Sunday against the Washington Commanders after missing a practice earlier in the week because of knee soreness.

headline: Saquon Barkley, DeVonta Smith among Eagles ruled out vs. Jaguars
summary: Eagles running back Saquon Barkley, receiver DeVonta Smith, new starting center Drew Kendall, safety Marcus Epps and receiver Hollywood Brown were all ruled out for Sunday's game in London against the Jaguars.
